best_observed.configuration: K=3 plus six or more energy-ordered secondary retained pairs

observations: Exact signed retention monotonically improves or preserves the lower certificate.
For the declared energy ordering, counts depend only on the total number K+J of retained pairs, not on their exact regrouping into clusters.
At K=3, adding four signed secondary pairs increases certificates from 11521 to 12644.
The finite candidate frequency sets saturate near 12672 certificates in this benchmark.
No asymptotic lower bound or Goldbach theorem is claimed.
